name: Skunk Registry
tagline: Compliance paperwork for people who'd rather be growing.
positioning: Skunk Registry turns state cannabis rules into plain checklists, auto-filled forms, and audit-ready records for home growers and one-shop operators.

hero.h1: Stay legal without reading 400 pages of statute.
hero.sub: Skunk Registry watches your state's cannabis rules so you don't have to. Track plant counts, log every gram, and generate the exact form the inspector asks for — before they ask.

features.title: The rulebook, minus the rulebook
features.description: We read your state's cannabis code so you never open a PDF again. Get a plain-English checklist that updates itself when regulators move the goalposts.

features.title: Seed-to-shelf logging
features.description: Log plants, harvests, and transfers in seconds from your phone. Every entry is timestamped and locked, so your records hold up when someone official comes knocking.

features.title: Plant-count guardrails
features.description: Tell us your license type and we flag the moment you drift over your legal limit — before it becomes a fine with your name on it.

features.title: Audit mode
features.description: One tap builds the exact packet an inspector wants: forms, logs, and chain-of-custody, formatted per state. No frantic 2am spreadsheet archaeology.

features.title: Deadline radar
features.description: Renewals, tax filings, and reporting windows land on a calendar that nags you politely, then insistently, then dramatically.

features.title: Works in your state
features.description: Rulesets for 30+ legal markets, each maintained by humans who actually track the bulletins so you're never compliant with last year's law.

testimonials.quote: I was tracking my cultivation license in a spreadsheet named 'final_FINAL_v3.' Skunk Registry replaced the whole disaster and passed my first METRC audit without a single follow-up.
testimonials.name: Delia Marsh

testimonials.quote: Our micro-dispensary can't afford a compliance officer. This is the compliance officer, and it doesn't take lunch or misfile the transfer manifests.
testimonials.name: Rowan Ideh

testimonials.quote: The deadline radar caught a renewal window I'd genuinely forgotten existed. That one email saved my license. Worth every dollar and then some.
testimonials.name: Priya Vance

pricing.blurb: For the single-plot grower who just wants to stay on the right side of the law.
For serious home growers and solo operators who file real paperwork.

homepage.footerBlurb: Skunk Registry is compliance software, not a law firm. We keep your records clean; you keep your license. Available in 30+ legal markets.
